claim: Jev is scored under the Program 1 Choice contract and metric definitions on the Program 1 items in artifacts/splits.json. This file was written before any Jev response on a dataset item. A synthetic sentence was used to check the request and response shape.

request.state: the item text, as one string
request.instructions: Which label best describes the text?
request.criteria: one key per frozen Program 1 label string, in frozen order, each with a null description

scores.source: the probabilities map of the answer, read in frozen label order
scores.missing_label: the row is an error and is not scored
scores.unscaled: softmax of the scores, which is the returned distribution renormalised
scores.scaled: softmax of scores / T, with T fit on dev by the Program 1 rule

decision: argmax_lowest_index_on_ties over the frozen labels, as in Program 1. The vendor's own choice field is recorded and its agreement with that argmax is reported.

latency.what: wall-clock milliseconds of the HTTPS call that returned the answer, from this desktop, including network and any gateway

retry.other_statuses: the row is an error and is not retried

resume: A finished item_id in the output file is not requested again.

replay.what: The first 50 test items of each dataset are requested a second time after the main pass. Reported: the fraction whose argmax changed and the largest absolute probability change.

data_leaves_machine: Item texts and label strings are sent to TypeSafe. All three datasets are public.
